name: p0-spike
description: A prototype or technical spike for engine core mechanics.

scripts.build: if [ -n "$CHUGGIE_PREBUILT_ROM" ] && [ -f "$npm_package_name.gba" ]; then echo "using the prebuilt $npm_package_name.gba"; else cargo build --release && agb-gbafix ../../target/thumbv4t-none-eabi/release/p0-spike -o p0-spike.gba; fi
scripts.start: npm run build && (mgba-qt p0-spike.gba || mgba p0-spike.gba)
